does: Each tick it gathers who is to be surprised - first the creatures joining a fight whose party or allied combat group already holds a surprised member, then the allies of every creature that carries a new stealth request - and gives each esv::combat::SurprisedJoinRequestOneFrameComponent.

evidence.says: the Toolkit exports esv::combat::SurprisedSystem::Update at EoCServer.dll+0x14961A0 with the same two calls and the same loop that adds the join request
two gatherers fill one set, then every member of the set gets the one-frame join request
in a hidden archer's shot at one of two hostile humans the target gets the stealth request in the tick it joins and its ally the join request one tick later
